mechanisms: The Agitator at pun_site (seat 1, corpun_27143, 1274 metal): a 1300-metal tower raised for 2:35 on a metal store at 0 (income about 20 a second shared with the plant), after a 26 s blocked-site start delay (17:50-18:16, constructor_12478's watchdog line), died at 98% to a lone Tzar; an unblocked start alone would plausibly have finished it near 20:25, while the Tzar still stood about 1,100 away at F5 (the 20:30 report), and funding it first (nothing else drawing metal while it stood) earlier still: 1274 metal.

A frame hidden by the 60% queue-ahead (seat 0 cornanotc_15475 179 metal, seat 1 cornanotc_4226 223 metal, and the never-started second nano of seat 0 at 8:55): once the next step is queued, the hands and the report treat the queued step as the builder's course and lose the frame still being built, so a re-list either takes a step as done on that frame and sends the next one unqueued (seat 0) or replaces it without the 'build in progress finishes' protection (seat 1); treating any frame the builder is still building as the build in progress, and saying it in the entry ('building X (N%), then Y queued'), keeps 402 metal of nanos.

Builds in a factory's exit lane (seat 0 corestor_16891 116 and corwin_18235 29, seat 1 corsolar_28743 78 and corrl_14191 16, seat 2 armsolar_13067 29, seat 3 armwin_8832 24: 292 metal in six frames): the pick, the lists' place-less steps and named places put builders or frames in the lane; the wake line about the blocked lane then made the player drop the frame on purpose each time; a keep-out of the lane in every placement would have kept them.
unread: The side surrendered at 22:53 (bot.log: "[strategist] surrender at 22:53"); the record runs to 22:59. Nothing torn; every seat read (seats 1-3 through symlink directories for hands_window-style reads; my own reader for the hands' log because hands_window.py prints no menu ratings for this game: its worlds_gate lines fall on other frames than the pass lines). Caveats: frames.py lists 30 'never started' orders (7/10/7/6 by seat) that did start at the site the engine placed more than 300 from the commanded point, and several more fulfilled by another builder of the same id or place, so its never_started counts overstate; the report's '% built' and the record's health share disagree at times (seat 1 nano at 9:05: 94% in the report against 53-64% in the record; seat 3 armsolar_3741 at 22:37: 93% against at most 68%), and frames.py's share and metal_in come from the record, so they may understate; the 'abandoned ... (N% built)' lines give the share at decay (1% for a nano left at 78-97%).
